Lets the assistant look things up on Google — news, weather, scores, prices — when you ask something it can\'t answer itself. What you ask is sent to Google Search. Takes effect on the next conversation.
Requires a paid Gemini plan (billing enabled on your API key). On a free key Google refuses it, and the assistant carries on without searching.

Start speaking while it is talking and it stops and listens. Turn off if it ever cuts itself off by mistake.
Lets the assistant actually operate car controls, not just talk about them.
This lets the assistant actually operate the car\'s climate, windows, seats and similar controls when asked. It is experimental: use it only while parked, and at your own risk.

Not confirmed. Switch this app on in the head unit\'s auto-start screen: otherwise it can close the app when the car sleeps or restarts, which turns the steering-wheel button off until you open the app again.

A few things this assistant needs before it can talk back.
Required — your voice is sent to Gemini for a spoken reply. Choose “While using the app” (or “Allow”): “Only this time” expires and the assistant silently stops working.
Recommended — lets the app tell you when a new version is available.
Recommended — lets the mic button on the steering wheel start listening. It only watches that one button. Needs ADB debugging switched on for this head unit.
From Google AI Studio. Stored encrypted on-device, never sent anywhere but Google\'s API.

BYD Assistant NG is an independent project. It is not made, approved or supported by BYD or Google; the names BYD, DiLink and Gemini belong to their owners.

The app is provided “as is”, without any warranty. You use it entirely at your own responsibility — including everything it says and everything it does to your car. Vehicle control is experimental: use it only when it is safe to do so, never let it distract you from driving, and check that the car did what you asked.

What you say is sent to Google's Gemini service, and to Google Search if you turn on web search.

BYD Assistant NG is free, open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3. You can read the code, report problems and contribute improvements through the project page. Verified vehicle controls for other models are especially welcome.
Kotlin and kotlinx.serialization, AndroidX and Jetpack Compose, OkHttp, Dagger Hilt and Dadb — all open source under the Apache License 2.0. The licence texts are available from each project.
